Vacancy for Technician and Animal House Keeper
Wednesday, 16 April 2025
1799 Hits
Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the below mentioned posts which must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
28/04/2025
.
Registration with Local Employment Exchange is mandatory, copy of the same to be submitted along with application
.
Skilled Technician (IT)
– 1 Post
Qualification & Experience:
Must be B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics & Telecommunication from recognized University in India, MSCIT / equivalent qualification with proficiency in computer systems, hardware, software, troubleshooting and at least 3 years’ experience in Medical / Engineering / Private Institutions. Candidate having Diploma in Data Sciences will be preferred.
Animal House Keeper
: 1 Post
Qualification & Experience:
Must be HSC from recognized board with 1 year experience in handling, feeding and care of animals, especially those used in medical research or animal facilities.
Salary:
As per Kasturba Health Society’s Rules
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for General category / between 18-43 for reserved category
Note:
1.
Application to be submitted to the Dean, MGIMS for the above mentioned post.
Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
Dean reserves right to reject any or all application.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final and binding.
Only eligible candidates will be called for Written / Skill test and shortlisted candidates
will be called for document verification / Interview.
DEAN
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
